heading: About
body:
I'm Shota Mtvarelishvili, based in Tbilisi, Georgia. I write about things I find interesting.

I also run and maintain [Lockwell](https://lockwell.org/), free practical guides to online privacy and security in Georgian and English.

You can reach me at [mtvarelishvili@proton.me](mailto:mtvarelishvili@proton.me).
